properties.message_511: On I-64 at mile marker 175 in the County of Goochland, motorists can expect delays due to a vehicle crash. The east right shoulder is closed.
On I-95 at mile marker 137.7 in the County of Stafford, motorists can expect delays due to a tractor trailer crash. The north right shoulder is closed.
On I-66W Express Lanes at mile marker 60.1 in the County of Fairfax, motorists can expect potential delays due to a disabled vehicle. The west left shoulder is closed.
